findings.finding: Two acceptance criteria state different hard module-size caps: one says 'none > 700' while the last says 'all src/rebar files ≤ 800' — a cross-section numeric inconsistency for the same gate.

findings.suggested_fix: Clarify: '≤800' is the CI gate that must stay green; '≤700' is this ticket's self-imposed hard ceiling (with 200-500 the target). State that the ticket enforces the stricter 700 while the CI gate remains 800.
